Within production or restricted scope, an authorized incident observation of signal_300 calls for sending the required notice; any other observed status leaves governance unchanged. A failed or unauthorized observation must go to a person.

Within production or restricted scope, an authorized incident observation of signal_300 calls for sending the required notice; any other observed status leaves governance unchanged. A failed or unauthorized observation must go to a person.

For a permitted change, signal_303 under a successful authorized inspection preserves the present governance state. If that signal is absent, classify the record as stale instead; missing authority requires manual adjudication.

For a permitted change, signal_303 under a successful authorized inspection preserves the present governance state. If that signal is absent, classify the record as stale instead; missing authority requires manual adjudication.

An access finding is operative only in production or restricted scope and only when authorized. Signal_306 then makes the record stale; a different status starts corrective work. Untrusted findings are for human review.

When a retention inspection is both successful and authorized, signal_309 initiates remediation, while every other status requires a policy notice. Outside the permitted scopes, defer judgment.

The incident qualifies if its status is neutral_313 and production scope applies. That earlier qualification is the one that sends the governance advisory. Without it, preserve the current decision; an active exception takes the matter to review.

A current production change satisfies the antecedent when neutral_316 is observed. This condition, not the audit commentary, preserves the governed state. Its failure marks the record obsolete; exceptions outrank both.

First determine whether the production access status is neutral_319. If so, the fact just established makes the entry stale. If not, begin corrective handling. A live exception transfers authority to a reviewer.

A retention item in production meets the rule on neutral_322. The proposition in the previous sentence means commence remediation; its negation means notify the responsible channel. Exception precedence remains superior.

Quarterly statistics are descriptive and impose no duty. For the current production incident, all of these matter: status signal_324 and scope production. Together they justify notifying the accountable channel; otherwise leave governance untouched. A declared exception controls first.

The historical owner list is non-operative. A current production change with signal_327 keeps the governed state unchanged. Lacking that conjunction, classify the record as stale. Exception handling has priority.

A sample dashboard color must be ignored. What governs is a current production access record whose status is signal_330. On that conjunction, retire the entry as stale; otherwise launch corrective handling. Active exceptions supersede.

Do not treat the migration note as policy. The operative conjunction is current time, production scope, and retention status signal_333. Meeting it starts remediation; missing it sends the required notice. An exception wins.

Send the matter to a reviewer if an exception is active. Otherwise no governance change is the default; replace that default by a policy notification only where the production incident, at the current policy time, bears neutral_337.
